confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback text extraction, rendered methods pages, and the tracked supplement-route ledger were checked. The paper reports the static speaker geometry, sound classes, SPL, tactile apparatus, trial families, block/order rule, response procedure, and Experiment 1 repetitions. Remaining gaps are exact ITI/jitter, numeric response timeout, exact source sound files/envelopes, and a supplement/manual-methods source.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The study can be recreated as a static free-field peri-head auditory-tactile extinction task with near/far/front/back speaker positions and white-noise or tone stimuli. It is not a dynamic looming profile; a toolkit version would need a static-position condition family rather than a moving sound trajectory.

source_checks.scope: PDF pages 2, 11, and 12 for figures, Materials and Procedure, Experiment 1, Experiment 2, trial types, and counts.
Used as primary text map, then checked against rendered PDF pages and targeted search.
Targeted searches for speaker, tone, white noise, 20 cm, 70 cm, SPL, sensor, catch, pseudorandom, block, response, and protocol repetition terms.
Visual methods-page check; temporary rendered page images were not committed.
Tracked ledger marks the supplement route as paywalled/access-limited, with no local supplement available for this review.

review_attempts.result: Mapped candidate Segment 1-4 values across 17 of 25 fields.
Confirmed sound type, near/far/front/back static speaker geometry, SPL, tactile site, response labels, condition count, trial count, and repetition of the protocol.
Local text search confirmed the page-11 and page-12 methods details and found no numeric ITI/jitter or response-timeout value.
Rendered methods pages were visually checked to verify the transition from apparatus to Experiment 1 and Experiment 2 procedures.
Separated static free-field speaker positions from dynamic looming trajectories and recorded the Exp. 1 and Exp. 2 auditory condition sets.

review_attempts.strategy: Sequence, baseline, catch, and count pass
review_attempts.result: Identified blocked conditions, same pseudorandom trial order, 10 trials per trial type, no-stimulation catches, tactile-only baseline, and two full Exp. 1 protocol runs.
No local supplement was available; tracked acquisition ledgers mark supplementary/methods routes as paywalled or access-limited.

stimulus_type.value: Two auditory stimulus classes: wideband white-noise bursts and pure tones at 1.5 kHz.
stimulus_type.page_or_section: PDF pp.2, 11, Figure 1 and Materials and Procedure
stimulus_type.evidence_note: Figure 1 and methods identify white noise and 1.5 kHz pure tones.

source_provenance.value: Sounds were generated by a sensor/switch circuit controlling a loudspeaker; exact source sound files or waveform assets are not supplied.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Apparatus provenance is reported, but no reusable audio asset is provided.

trajectory_count.value: Static position set: Exp. 1 has eight cross-modal auditory conditions from front/back x 20/70 cm x sound type; Exp. 2 has two back-left white-noise distance conditions.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: The task manipulates static speaker positions rather than motion paths.

trajectory_path.value: Exp. 1 speaker positions were right-front/right-back at 20 cm or 70 cm from the head, at ear level and 45 degrees from the sagittal plane; Exp. 2 mirrored this to left-back 20/70 cm.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Methods specify near/far front/back quadrants, ear level, and final 45 degree placement.

stimulus_duration.value: Sound duration equaled the contact time between the sensor and skin; tactile contacts were brief, under 1 second.
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Duration rule is reported, but not an exact millisecond value.

stimulus_speed.value: No auditory movement speed: sounds were emitted from static free-field speaker positions.
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: The paper varies position and distance, not moving-source speed.

auditory_conditions.value: Exp. 1 crossed sound type with front/back space and near/far distance on the right side; Exp. 2 used only white-noise bursts from left-back near/far positions.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: Condition factors are explicit in the experiment descriptions.

gain_envelope.value: Sound pressure level at the patient's ear was set to 70 dB for every loudspeaker position and sound type; no temporal envelope or ramp is reported.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: Methods report constant 70 dB SPL and sound-meter adjustment.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Free-field loudspeaker apparatus: 0.3 W, 8 ohm speaker at ear level on an adjustable stand, touch-sensitive sensor, remote switch, and optically isolated circuit.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: Methods list apparatus components and speaker placement.

trial_rows_families.value: Unimodal tactile trials and cross-modal auditory-tactile trials, each with unilateral, bilateral/simultaneous, and no-stimulation catch rows.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The four trial types are listed for tactile and cross-modal conditions.

condition_intermixing.value: Main auditory factors were blocked by condition; within each condition, trial types were presented in the same pseudorandom order.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: The condition and trial-order structure is explicit.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Conditions were run per block, and block order was randomized across sessions and subjects.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: The paper reports both condition blocking and randomized block order.

iti_jitter_policy.page_or_section: PDF pp.11-12; supplement route ledger checked 2026-06-16
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: No ITI, inter-trial interval, jitter value, or distribution was found after main-PDF, targeted, fallback, and supplement-route checks.

response_window.page_or_section: PDF p.12; supplement route ledger checked 2026-06-16
response_window.evidence_note: Immediate verbal report and prompting are reported, but no numeric timeout, deadline, or scoring window was found.

task_sequence_rules.value: Before each stimulation the experimenter verbally prompted attention; patients reported left/right/both/none regardless of modality after the event.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: Instructions and response labels are reported for both task families.

tactile_stimulus.value: Brief light contact under 1 second using a 1 cm2 touch-sensitive sensor on the lateral neck behind the ear, below the mastoid process.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Tactile site, tool, and approximate duration are reported.

soa_table.value: Bimodal cross-modal trials used simultaneous sound and touch; there was no varied SOA ladder.
soa_table.evidence_note: The paper describes simultaneous touch-plus-sound trials.

baseline_strategy.value: Unimodal tactile condition served as the tactile baseline, with the switch off so sensors did not trigger sounds.
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: Baseline tactile-only condition is explicitly described.

baseline_timing.value: Baseline timing used the same manual tactile-contact structure without an auditory event; no SOA values apply.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: Switch-off baseline retains tactile contact but omits sound.

catch_trial_type.value: No-stimulation catch trials appeared in tactile and cross-modal conditions; cross-modal conditions also included single-sound trials without touch.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Catch rows and single-sound rows are listed in the procedure.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Each condition had 40 trials: 10 single-left, 10 single-right, 10 bilateral/simultaneous, and 10 catch; the whole Experiment 1 protocol was run twice.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: Trial-type counts and protocol repetition are explicit.

baseline_count.value: Exp. 1 tactile-only baseline block: 1 condition x 40 trials x 2 protocol runs = 80 trials per patient, including 60 tactile-present trials and 20 no-stimulation catches.
baseline_count.evidence_note: Derived from the reported baseline condition, 40-trial condition size, and two full protocol runs.

catch_count.value: Exp. 1 no-stimulation catches: 9 conditions x 10 catch trials x 2 protocol runs = 180 per patient; 160 are in cross-modal blocks and 20 in tactile baseline blocks.
catch_count.evidence_note: Derived from reported condition count, catch row count, and two full protocol runs.

block_count.value: Exp. 1 used nine condition blocks per protocol, with the full protocol completed twice in separate sessions; Exp. 2 added two cross-modal condition blocks for the subgroup.
block_count.evidence_note: Condition blocking and two full Exp. 1 protocol runs are reported.

total_trial_count.value: Exp. 1 total per patient: 9 conditions x 40 trials x 2 protocol runs = 720 trials; the cross-modal subset alone is 640 trials.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: Derived from reported condition count, 40 trials per condition, and two protocol runs.

critical_caveats: The task is a static free-field speaker-position extinction task, not a dynamic looming/receding profile.
Exact source sound files, white-noise generation method, pure-tone waveform settings, and onset/offset envelopes are not provided.
Auditory/tactile duration is only specified as manual contact duration under 1 second, not an exact millisecond value.
No ITI, jitter distribution, or between-trial timing rule was found.
Immediate verbal response is described, but no numeric response window or scoring deadline is reported.
No local supplement was available; the tracked supplement/methods route is paywalled or access-limited.
next_manual_action: This record is strong enough to recreate a static peri-head free-field auditory-tactile extinction task, but not a standard looming profile. A runnable template would need static speaker-position conditions and approximations for sound files, onset envelope, ITI, and response timeout.
